summary: Implements the `beep quality fallow` subcommand tree: it shells out to the Fallow quality tool per feature lane (audit, dead-code, health, boundaries, flags, security, fix-preview), normalizes raw Fallow JSON into a schema-first report envelope written to .beep/fallow, and additionally provides envelope-check, command-contract-check (self-probing dispatch tests), boundaries config-check, and CI workflow YAML contract validation.

concerns.name: Raw Fallow report schemas
concerns.description: S.Class/S.Struct shapes for every raw Fallow JSON output (audit, dead-code, health, flags, security detailed+summary union, fix-preview) plus their S.decodeUnknownOption decoders and the per-feature hasFallowReportShape matcher.

concerns.name: Pure finding-normalization and attribution domain logic
concerns.description: Converts raw Fallow counts/arrays into synthetic FallowReportFinding lists with attribution kinds, the promoted-blocking-lane policy, the test-only-duplication carve-out, and the DoS cap maxFindingsPerCount. Entirely pure, no Effect environment.

concerns.name: Child-process execution and git probing
concerns.description: ChildProcess.make wrappers collecting stdout/stderr/exit code concurrently, optional-output fallback, git dirty-worktree and base-ref resolution, plus output-massaging helpers (JSON extraction, tool-version regex, stderr excerpting). collectText duplicates internal/QualityArtifactSupport.ts:749.

concerns.name: Envelope construction, persistence, and lane orchestration
concerns.description: Builds ok/failure FallowReportEnvelope variants from process results, resolves report+raw output paths, encodes/writes both artifacts, decides exit behavior (advisory/check/blocking), and the main runFallowFeature entrypoint including per-feature fallowArgs CLI argument tables.

concerns.name: Envelope validation diagnostics (envelope-check)
concerns.description: Exact-key and invariant diagnostics over decoded envelopes (findingCount vs findings length, attribution summary consistency, failure-status exit codes), a S.check wire-guard schema, and the checkEnvelopePath command body.

concerns.name: Self-testing contract probes with inline fixtures
concerns.description: command-contract-check machinery: re-invokes the public CLI per lane, validates emitted envelopes against probe start time and raw-output mtime, injects synthetic process results for failure statuses, and carries ~190 LOC of inline invalid-raw-report fixture data.

concerns.name: CI workflow YAML contract check
concerns.description: Parses a GitHub Actions workflow with yaml.parseDocument and asserts the fallow-advisory job wires the envelope wrapper correctly (lane loops, envelope paths, --check/--advisory flags, upload-artifact steps). Exports fallowCiUploadDiagnosticsForTesting for the test suite.

concerns.name: Generic unknown-probing and string utilities
concerns.description: Untyped-JSON property probes (record/string/number/array Option getters), csvValues, slugify, normalizePath, nonCommentLines, missingDiagnostic/presentDiagnostic, failWithDiagnostics, formatEpochMillis. unknownRecordProperty is duplicated in Quality.command.ts:1832 and csvValues in Yeet/internal/FallowFeedback.ts:355.

risks: bin-main.ts:185 lazily imports ./commands/Quality/Tasks.js as the CLI fast path before the full command tree loads — Tasks.ts must keep exporting parseQualityTaskInvocation/runQualityTask AND its transitive import graph must stay light, or every `bun run beep <task>` startup slows down.

package.json exports wildcard "./commands/*": "./src/commands/*.ts" makes @beep/repo-cli/commands/Quality/Tasks a live public specifier: src/test/Quality.test-kit.ts star-exports it, test/quality-tasks.test.ts consumes ~15 symbols through it, and many JSDoc @example blocks (compiled by docgen check) reference it — dropping any current export breaks tests and the docgen gate.

$I = $RepoCliId.create("commands/Quality/Tasks") embeds the module path in every schema identity; moving S.Class/LiteralKit declarations changes schema identifiers and the tracked generated schema catalog (P3, commit 5783560) — catalog must be regenerated and anything keying on identifier strings re-verified.

State/ordering subtleties: withRyukDisabledDuringAcquire mutates globalThis.process.env under acquireUseRelease, isCi() reads Bun.env at call time, and acquireTestcontainersSqlIntegrationResource is a module-level effect value — splits must not turn lazy call-time evaluation into import-time evaluation or reorder the env save/restore.

Export-star collision hazard: Tasks.ts re-exports Quality.errors while Quality/index.ts also star-exports them, and the test-kit star-exports both plus Quality.command — after a split, any divergent duplicate binding across those modules gets silently dropped by export *; the dual()-wrapped testing exports (rootQualityStepsForTesting, sqlIntegrationStepForTesting) are also arity-sensitive under the dual-arity law lint.

test/quality-artifact-generators.test.ts imports writeJSDocDocumentationInventory via the @beep/repo-cli/test/Quality alias (package.json ./test/* export map) — the facade path and symbol must survive verbatim.

New non-facade files with exported symbols must carry full @example/@category/@since JSDoc plus $I annotations to pass this repo's own docgen and jsdoc-inventory gates (this file is itself an input to the crispening ratchet, and the branch already touches quality-adjacent files).
